info.name: AccuWeather One Active Storms Resolve Location Redirect API
AccuWeather Takes in a Location as a Query Parameter

params.name: LocationType
params.description: The type of location to resolve. Eg. address, postalCode, place, locality

params.name: PostalCode
params.description: The postal code of the location to resolve.

params.name: City
params.description: The city of the location to resolve.

params.name: AdminCode
params.description: The admin code for the location.

params.name: CountryCode
params.description: The country code for the location.

params.name: Position
params.description: Comma separated position of the location to resolve. Longitude, Latitude.

params.name: Name
params.description: Simple name for a location, such as the name of a city

params.name: LongName
params.value: 385 Science Park Rd, State College, PA
params.description: Full name for a location, such as the name of an Admin or address

params.name: Language
params.description: Language for the query to use for the response.
